name: wf-audit
description: wf audit pack — the audit capability (five domain-free adversarial verify lenses: correctness, security, convention, consistency, operational, plus an optional composite retrospective report) co-located with the sr capability (a lightweight pre-commit adversarial self-review lens that reuses the audit correctness rubric intra-plugin). Composed with wf core via the capability registry; the verify phase aggregates the five lenses' findings and the pre-commit seam dispatches the sr lens when registered. Dependency-free (no requires) — composes in bare-core mode too. Ships /wf-audit:init for one-command self-registration of both capabilities.
